links.plain: early <200-ms feedforward local sensory wave (Subliminal & Preconscious)
links.function: encoding flashed letters and shapes linearly in early occipital-temporal cortex even on trials where the viewer consciously reports seeing a blank screen
links.narration_bridge: Establishes preserved early sensory coding without conscious access (SRC1, SRC3).

links.plain: inferior parietal attentional gate & workspace hub (~270–300 ms)
links.function: opening the preconscious bottleneck and locking into reciprocal long-range white-matter conduction with frontal hubs at the 50-ms masking threshold
links.narration_bridge: Key posterior limb of Dehaene's frontoparietal workspace.

links.function: sustaining coherent internal tract conduction across bilateral prefrontal-parietal loops so the perceived word can be held in working memory and spoken aloud
links.narration_bridge: Core GNW conscious-access signature (Dehaene et al. 2006 SRC1; 2011 SRC2).
